values.note: Huron County Parks, 2026: electric and water $55 a night, full hookup $73, full hookup lakefront $78; each +$5 on holidays and -$5 in the off season. Seasonal sites from $4,600. One rate for everyone (no resident/non-resident split posted). $15 cancellation fee.

fees.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/caseville-county-park ('Camping Rates: Electric and Water $55 per night + $5 Holidays -$5 Off Season Discount; Full Hookup $73; Full Hookup Lakefront $78; Seasonal $4,600+'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/caseville-county-park ('Open May 1 - October 26, 2026') + https://huroncountyparks.com/caseville-park-reservations ('Park Open May 1 - Oct 26'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/caseville-county-park ('water & electric sites, full hookup sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Coin-operated showers. Wi-Fi only at designated hotspots, not at the sites.

facilities.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/caseville-county-park ('Bath houses with coin operated showers and flush toilets are available'; 'Wi-Fi available ... only designated hotspot areas - not at individual campsites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booked online through Huron County Parks' Checkfront page or by phone (888-265-2583). The next season opens to the public around December 1 (2026 season: Dec 1, 2025, noon). Holiday weekends need 3 consecutive nights. No cancellations within 30 days or over holidays/special events. Seasonal sites go each January to the Seasonal Interest List; parks are at capacity for seasonals.

booking.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/caseville-park-reservations ('All 2026 Reservations Open to the General Public on Monday, Dec. 1 at 12pm EST'; Checkfront 'Book a Site' link) + https://huroncountyparks.com/park-rules ('All reservations for holiday weekends will be a minimum of three consecutive nights') + https://huroncountyparks.com/seasonal-rentals, read 2026-10-22

note: Huron County Parks (county government) campground, 6400 Main St, Caseville, on Saginaw Bay (Lake Huron), with one of the state's nicer beaches; the town's shops are walkable. Electric & water, full-hookup and lakefront full-hookup nightly sites plus seasonal and mobile-home sites; pavilions and a playscape. Tents not allowed on full-hookup sites. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the county's pages (2026): $55 electric/water, $73 full hookup, $78 lakefront full hookup (+$5 holidays, -$5 off season, no resident split), water and sewer hookups, coin showers and flush toilets, reservable online; phone (989) 856-2080 matches. Changed season close 10-31 -> 10-26 (2026 dates). Added Checkfront booking url, 3-night holiday minimum, Dec 1 booking opening, wifi at hotspots. Note cleaned of season/booking/price text the fields hold. Seasonal sites exist (from $4,600, waitlist, 'at capacity') but the seasonal share is not stated; nightly sites are sold online. Dump station not restated (left derived); amperage not stated.
